_comment: CLOSING template for the data-use demo, English.
This is the second half of the bookend, and it exists for one specific
group: people who never replied to the opener at all. They never opened the
24-hour window, so every message to them is business-initiated and a
free-form send fails with 63016. An approved template is the only way to
reach them - which is the whole reason the bookend rule asks for one.
Why bother reaching them. A respondent who was contacted and did not answer
is left not knowing whether something is still expected of them. Closing
the loop tells them the exercise is over, that no reply is needed, and that
they will not be contacted again. That is closure, and it is the courteous
half of a contact we initiated.
The flow's other three closings are NOT this template. Complete, declined
and stopped-midway all have an inbound reply within the last hour, so they
are in session and send free-form bodies - which lets each carry its own
longer, outcome-specific text, including the reveal of the experiment.
Undeliverable gets nothing at all: a number that could not receive the
first message cannot receive this one either.
Framed for UTILITY. It concludes an exchange the recipient was part of,
states plainly that nothing further is required, and asks for nothing. No
incentive, no persuasion, no link.
Deliberately has no reveal of the A/B design. Somebody who never answered
saw one message and has no context for it; explaining the experiment to
them would be confusing rather than interesting.
Submission is irreversible - Meta has no edit operation - so review the
wording here first. This file is the only home for the copy: the flow's
`close_never_started` widget references it by SID and carries no text of
its own, so there is nothing here to keep in sync.

twilio/text.body:
Hi {{1}}, thank you for your time. The short WhatsApp survey we sent for the Research Staff Training 2026 has now closed.

No reply is needed from you, and we will not message you about it again.

If you would like to see what the exercise showed, join us at the session during the training.

_IPA Team_
